senses.gloss: कृश- + अङ्ग कृश- + अङ्ग, adj., f. गी, meagre.
कृष्ण- + अजिन कृष्ण- + अजिन, n. the hide of the black antelope.
कृष्ण- + अयस् कृष्ण- + अयस्, n. iron, MBh. 13, 6225.
कृष्णायस् कृष्णायस्, i. e. कृष्ण-अयस्, and कृष्णायस कृष्णायस् + अ, n. Iron.
कृश- + उदर कृश- + उदर, adj., f. री, slender, Vikr. d. 154.
कृष्ण- + उरग कृष्ण- + उरग, m. a black kind of snake, Draup. 5, 8.

कृश् कृश्, i. 4, Par.
 1. To become thin (ved.).
 2. To make thin.
 --Caus. कर्शय, To cause to become thin, Suśr. 2, 196, 6.
 कर्शित, Emaciated, Rām. 1, 54, 2.
 --With the prep. वि वि, Caus. To cause to become thin, Bhāg. P. 1, 16, 25.
 --Cf. κολέκ + ανος, κολόκανος, κολοσσός for κολοκϳος; Lat. gracilis.

कृष् कृष्, i. 1, Par. (in epie poetry also Ātm., e. g. MBh. 1, 6289),
 1. To draw, MBh. 1, 6468; Ragh. 9, 27 (an arrow to the ear).
 2. To draw (a bow), Ragh. 5, 20.
 3. To drag along, MBh. 1, 6001.
 4. To lead, Chr. 54, 14 (Ātm.).
 5. To bear, MBh. 13, 4580.
 6. To tear, MBh. 1, 5992.
 7. To allure, Lass. 85, 2.
 8. To subdue, Man. 2, 215.
 9. To attain, MBh. 3, 66.
 10. i. 1, Par., and i. 6, Par., Ātm., To draw furrows, to plough, Rām. 3, 4, 12 (i. 1); Yājñ. 2, 150 (i. 6, कृषाण, anom. instead of कृषमाण).
 11. To walk, MBh. 3, 16021.
 कृष्ट,
 1. Drawn, Śāk. d. 131.
 2. Ploughed, Pañc. i. d. 53.
 --Comp.
 --Absol. कृष्य, instead of कृष्ट्वा, Chr. 40, 10.
 --Caus. कर्षय,
 1. To drag, Mṛcch. 16, 25.
 2. To pluck out, MBh. 3, 2307.
 3. To distress, Man. 2, 24.
 4. To oppress, Man. 7, 111.
 --All the following are inflected after i. 1: With the prep. अनु अनु, To drag after one's self Rām. 1, 54, 1 (Ātm.).
 --Caus. अनुकर्षित, Occupied, MBh. 13, 7281.
 --With अप अप,
 1. To draw away, MBh. 3, 10615; Rām. 6, 72, 68 (Ātm.).
 2. To remove, Rām. 5, 71, 5.
 3. To deduct, Suśr. 2, 40, 8.
 4. To put aside, Nal. 17, 33.
 5. To draw (a bow), MBh. 4, 1909.
 6. To humble, MBh. 13, 2186.
 अपकृष्ट,
 1. Lost, Nal. 9, 33.
 2. Inferior, Man. 5, 163.
 --Causal, To remove, MBh. 1, 6205.
 --With व्यप वि-अप,
 1. To drag away, Rām. 6, 88, 2.
 2. To cast off, MBh. 1 5104.
 3. To remove, Nal. 24, 41.
 4. To atone, Man. 11, 210.
 --With अभि अभि, To subdue, MBh. 3, 15064.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To draw away, Śāk. d. 173. []
 2. To cast off, MBh. 13, 5007 (reflective pass.).
 3. To remove, MBh. 2, 207.
 4. To draw down, Suśr. 2, 291, 1.
 अवकृष्त, Inferior, Man. 8, 177.
 --With व्यव वि-अव, To alienate, MBh. 13, 1642.
 --With आ आ.
 1. To draw near. Hit. i. d. 102.
 2. To draw (a sword), Mṛcch. 132, 5; (a bow) Śāk. d. 54.
 3. To draw on, Śāk. 5, 5.
 4. To drag along, Śāk. d. 32.
 5. To allure, Hit. 41, 14.
 6. To cast off, MBh. 2, 2291.
 7. To draw out, Lass. 22, 7.
 8. To take from, Hit. pr. d. 8; to withdraw, Rājat. 5, 69.
 --Caus. To draw near, Ṛt. 5, 11; to fetch, Pañc. 32, 17.
 --With अपा अप-आ, To remove, Rām. 2, 17, 9.
 --With व्यपा वि-अप-आ, To remove, MBh. 2, 2290.
 --With पर्या परि-आ, To drag about, MBh. 18, 9.
 --With व्या,
 1. To cast off, Rām. 5, 54, 15.
 2. To remove, Prab. 37, 7.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To drag near, MBh. 3, 10494; to fetch, Amar. 76.
 2. To take out (with abl.), Pañc. 40, 16.
 --Caus. To carry along, Pañc. 74, 23.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To raise, Bhāg. P. 5, 6, 10 (pass. to rise).
 2. To take out, MBh. 1, 7869.
 3. To cast off, MBh. 2, 1810.
 4. To draw (a bow), MBh. 4, 1635.
 उत्कृष्ट,
 1. Excessive, Rām. 3, 41, 5.
 2. Superior, Man. 5, 163.
 3. Distinguished, Man. 3, 132.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To raise, MBh. 1, 3613.
 --With उप उप, To draw near, Bhāg. P. 7, 9, 22.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To draw near, Rām. 2, 89, 10.
 --With नि नि, To sink into (a river), MBh. 1, 3616.
 निकृष्ट, Low, base, MBh. 1, 3067. n. Vicinity, Suśr. 1, 94, 4.
 --With संनि सम्-नि; संनिकृष्ट, Near, Rām. 3, 21, 5. n. Vicinity, Śāk. 23, 23.
 ˚टम्, adv. Near, [] Kumāras. 3, 2.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To draw out, MBh. 3, 16763.
 2. To tear, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 21; to dissolve, Rājat. 6, 272.
 --Caus. To destroy, Bhāg. P. 6, 5, 19.
 --With परा परा,
 1. To draw away, MBh. 2, 2227.
 2. To blame, MBh. 13, 2102.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To drag about, Rām. 2, 97, 30.
 2. To carry about with one, MBh. 17, 104.
 3. To lead, Rām. 6, 2, 28.
 --Caus. To torment, Rām. 1, 8, 13.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To drag away, MBh. 3, 12787.
 2. To draw (a bow), MBh. 4, 1959.
 3. To agitate, Rām. 5, 70, 11.
 4. To lead, Rām. 6, 2, 44.
 प्रकृष्ट,
 1. Long, Nal. 12, 111.
 2. Well to do, Man. 7, 170.
 3. Excellent, Pañc. 191, 16.
 4. Violent, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 4.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To conquer, MBh. 1, 7197.
 विप्रकृष्ट, Distant, Pañc. 127, 17.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To draw (a bow), Rām. 3, 34, 3; (an arrow) Rām. 6, 70, 39.
 2. To drag about, Rām. 2, 78, 16.
 3. To draw out, Bhartṛ. 1, 84 (to catch).
 4. To withdraw, Rājat. 5, 90.
 विकृष्ट, Long, Rām. 2, 68, 21.
 --With सम् सम्, To drag along, Rām. 5, 63, 19.
 --Cf. Lat. ac-cerso.

कृश कृश् + अ, adj., f. शा.
 1. Thin, emaciated, Suśr. 1, 53, 17.
 2. Weak, Hit. i. d. 196; Man. 7, 208.
 3. Poor, Man. 4, 184.
 --Comp.
कृशता कृश + ता, f., and कृशत्व कृश + त्व, n. Meagerness, MBh. 2, 1933; Pañc. i. d. 301.

कृशानु कृश् + आनु, m.
 1. A name of fire, Bhartṛ. 2, 67.
 2. A proper name, Chr. 297, 21 = Rigv. i. 112, 21.
कृशाश्व कृशाश्व, i. e. कृश-अश्व, m. A proper name, Rām. 1, 23, 12.
कृषक कृष् + अक, m. A husbandman, Cāṇ. 90.

कृषि कृष् + इ (कृषी कृषी, MBh. 1, 7207), f.
 1. Ploughing, Lass. 76, 18.
 2. Agriculture, Man. 1, 90.
कृषीवल कृषी + वल, m. A husbandman, Man. 9, 38.
कृष्टज कृष्ट-ज, adj. Cultivated, Man. 11, 144 (145).

कृष्ण कृष्ण, i. e. कृष् + न (the origin of the signification is dubious).
 I. adj., f. णा.
 1. Black, or dark blue, Rām. 3, 55, 5.
 2. With or without [] पक्ष, m. The dark half of a month, from the full moon to that of the new moon, Man. 1, 66; 6, 20.
 II. m.
 1. कृष्ण, The most celebrated incarnation of Viṣṇu, MBh. 14, 1589.
 2. The black antelope, Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 20.
 III. f. णा.
 1. A name of Durgā, MBh. 4, 184.
 2. The name of several plants, Suśr. 1, 162, 16.
 --Comp.
कृष्णता कृष्ण + ता, f., and कृष्णत्व कृष्ण + त्व, n. Blackness, Suśr. 1, 33, 20; MBh. 1, 4236.
कृष्णल कृष्ण + ल, m. and n. The berry of the plant Guñja, used as a weight; a coin of this weight, Man. 8, 215.
ऽकृष्णलक -कृष्णल + क, substitute for the last when latter part of a comp. adj., पञ्चकृष्णलक, i. e. पञ्चन्-, Comprising five कृष्णलस्, Man. 8, 134.
कृष्णाजिनिन् कृष्णाजिनिन्, i. e. कृष्ण-अजिन + इन्, adj., f. नी, Covered with the hide of the black antelope, MBh. 14, 2113.
कृष्णाय कृष्णाय, a denom. derived from कृष्ण by य, Ātm. To blacken, Hit. i. d. 74.
कृसर कृसर, m. A dish consisting of sesamum and grain, Man. 5, 7.
कृष्ण- + गति कृष्ण- + गति, m. fire, MBh. 13, 4071.
कृष्ण- + गोधा कृष्ण- + गोधा, f. a certain poisonous insect, Suśr. 2, 288, 9.
कृष्ण- + पक्ष कृष्ण- + पक्ष, m. the dark half of the month, the fifteen days during which the moon is in the wane, Man. 3, 276.
कृष्ण- + पिङ्गल कृष्ण- + पिङ्गल, adj., f. ला, of a fuscous colour.
कृष्ट- + फल कृष्ट- + फल, n. the value of the crop, Yājñ. 2, 158.
कृष्ण- + भोगिन् कृष्ण- + भोगिन्, m. a sort of black snake, Gīt. 6, 12.
कृष्ण- + मृग कृष्ण- + मृग, m. the black antelope, [] Śāk. d. 144.
कृष्ण- + लोह कृष्ण- + लोह, n. the loadstone, Suśr. 1, 142, 17. []
कृष्ण- + वर्त्मन् कृष्ण- + वर्त्मन्, m. fire, Man. 2, 94.
कृष्ण- + वेणा कृष्ण- + वेणा and तुङ्ग-वेणा, f. names of rivers, MBh. 3, 8180; 14233.
कृष्ण- + शार कृष्ण- + शार, adj. blue-black, Megh. 48, read -शार (Sch.).

कृष्ण- + सार कृष्ण- + सार (cf. शार),
 I. adj. of a blue-black colour, Rām. 5, 32, 47.
 II. m. 1. the black-pied antelope, Man. 2, 23; Vikr. d. 120. 2. the name of several plants.

कृष्ण- + सारङ्ग कृष्ण- + सारङ्ग,
 I. adj. blackpied.
 II. m. the black-pied antelope, Śāk. 61, 14 (v. r.).
कृषि- + सेवन कृषि- + सेवन, n. husbandry, Bhartṛ. 2, 91.
